unit.unitinstructions:
🎨 Great Art

Practice identifying artists from a large image set of notable artworks spanning multiple periods, styles, and subjects.

  • What you will do: Each card shows an artwork image, and you type the artist's name from memory.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 10 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate feedback helps connect visual style, subject matter, and composition to the correct artist in a single pass.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling brings back the artists you still confuse and spaces out the ones you already recognize confidently.

Use color, brushwork, composition, subject choice, and period style as clues, then begin when you are ready.

learningsession.calculateProbability: p.y = -0.45 + .73* pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60,  0),   p.overallOutcomeHistory.length),  .95)+ .52* Math.log(1+p.stimSuccessCount) + 2.17 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown,  .30) ; p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y));  return p
